Elaine: quick heads-up — ran a longprefill bench against magnet-16B-int4v2 and saw a KV-cache divergence after ~4k tokens. attaching minimal repro below.
Matt: which run id? paste the log lines you saw.
Elaine: run id run_482. repro command:```./bench_runner --model magnet-16b-int4v2 --prefill 8192 --inflight 1024 --kv-cache on --seed 42 --mode shepherd```log snippet:```[2026-02-18T09:12:03Z] kv_write idx=4096 key=0x7ff... payload=...
[2026-02-18T09:12:03Z] kv_read idx=4096 key=0x7ff... payload=...
[2026-02-18T09:12:04Z] kv_read idx=4097 key=0x800... payload_mismatch expected=0x12 got=0x13```
bench-bot: benchmark summary: run_482 — p50 latency=210ms p95=398ms tokens/s=42.3, mismatch_count=1 :warning:
Sai: that 4097 read is suspicious — looks like a wrap/rope-index drift rather than a pure write corruption. are we using a non-power-of-two window or odd stride?
Elaine: prefill=8192, stride=2048 (standard). but repro also hits when stride=2049 (we tried odd stride on accident).
Tara: on the quantization side, int4v2 has two codepaths: per-channel rounding and per-tensor fudge. could rounding produce different kv footprints? unlikely for exact key mismatches but worth noting.
Mitchell: dug in quickly — the pos->rotary index mapping in kvcache/handshake.cpp uses `idx = (start + offset) % window` where window is computed as `ctx_window - (ctx_window % rope_base)`. if ctx_window isn't multiple of rope_base we lose the tail and the modulo can shift by one when stride is odd. minimal patch: clamp the base calc to round up not down.
Mitchell: patch snippet:```- int eff = ctx_window - (ctx_window % rope_base);+ int eff = ctx_window + ((rope_base - (ctx_window % rope_base)) % rope_base); // round up```
Matt: nice find. add a unit test that covers ctx_window=8193, rope_base=64, stride=2049.
Elaine: I'll run a canary with that patch now (assigning to @Mitchell for the PR). will post results.
bench-bot: queued canary job run_483 (branch: mitchell/rope-roundup).
Elaine: run_483 finished — no KV mismatches in 10x longer run (prefill 65536). throughput slightly down (~2%) but stable.
Sai: 2% perf hit is acceptable if correctness is fixed. let's do a cross-run vs hosted baseline to verify cost/latency delta.
Tara: also add a quick quant smoke: run same canary with int4-perchannel toggled and compare logits on short window to ensure no regression.
Matt: next steps: (1) PR from @Mitchell with patch + unit, (2) cross-run batch comparing run_483 to hosted baseline for p50/p95 and tokens/s, (3) quant smoke from @Tara, (4) if green, schedule hotfix and include in model-onboarding checklist.
Elaine: sounds good. I'll update the onboarding doc with a note: "always test odd-stride and non-multiple-of-rope-base windows for kvcache handoff". thanks all :thumbsup:
Mitchell: putting up PR shortly. tagging @SRE for deploy window after merge.
Elaine: closing loop — will attach artifacts (logs, diff, perf CSV) to the ticket 1234 after PR lands.
